shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work and hauling, linked weather, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics (documented deviations: floor removal only drops on exposed air; bomb rooftop holes deferred).
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (T0-T3 all signed off in-game)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; StairTransfer moves pawns and carried cargo loss-proof; PageUp/PageDown camera-preserving level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, two lit unroofed face rows, fogged thick-roofed core, guaranteed fog reveal on mining.
- See-below renderer: content-only section copies at y=-2.5 (knowledge layers excluded by type), air-cells light mask (real per-cell light, night cap, world-anchored grid), live dynamic things below, far clip 70.
- Weather link: sky adopts ground weather every 150 ticks.
- Live sync (MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above; sky floors write roofs below; things over air fall.
- Cross-level work: virtual scan at the stairwell exit (emergency think instance skipped); idle return to surface; drafted gizmos; colony-wide Work/Schedule tables.
- Cross-level hauling: storage-driven (vanilla StoreUtility with pawn AND item virtually re-seated at the stairwell exit) plus construction-demand-driven with quantity-aware pinning; right-click haul-to-level orders; shared verdict caches. VERIFIED: both directions, pin coexistence, construction pull, no drops.
- Cross-level needs: bed redirect on linked levels; hunger and recreation via idle-return drift.
- One-colony resources: every column map's ResourceCounter counts all levels.

## Quadruple pass log
All T0-T3 passes archived in git history. Live-verified: work migration, idle return, cargo-through-stairs, storage and demand hauling, pin math, right-click orders, tables, visuals, weather.
Known gaps (candidates for T4/post-release): bills do not actively fetch across levels; patient/medical beds same-level; two-hop redirects fall back; autonomous cross-level fetch latency ~20s; Schedule ghouls current-map only; renderer polish backlog (far-zoom silhouettes below, water depth below, natural-roof removal under sky mountains, bomb rooftop holes, sky weather decider suppression).

## Tranche plan
- T0, T1, T2, T3 DONE and signed off.
- T4 (pending): temperature sync between levels, power across levels (conduits through stairs), threat policy (raids and levels), map-removal cleanup hooks, profiling pass, renderer polish picks.
- Publishing prep (per global workflow rules): field manual in _dev, BBCode Steam description, Preview.png, clean published folder.

## Status
T3 signed off in-game. Awaiting direction: T4 systems vs publishing prep first.
